definitions.explanation: Raising water to a higher place, typically with a pump. Also refers to pumped-storage hydroelectricity, in which water is pumped uphill to store energy.

examples.japanese: ポンプで{揚水|ようすい}する。
examples.english: to pump water up with a pump.

examples.japanese: {田|た}んぼに{揚水|ようすい}する。
examples.english: to pump water up to the rice paddies.

examples.japanese: この{発電所|はつでんしょ}は{夜間|やかん}に{揚水|ようすい}して{電気|でんき}をためる。
examples.english: This power station pumps water up at night to store electricity.

notes:
Raising water to a higher place, typically with a pump. Also names pumped-storage power generation, where water is pumped uphill during off-peak hours to be released later.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {揚水|ようすい}ポンプ: water-lifting pump
- {揚水|ようすい}{発電|はつでん}: pumped-storage power generation
- {田|た}に{揚水|ようすい}する: to pump water to the fields

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {用水|ようすい}: water for irrigation or general use — same reading, different kanji
